name: Hotkey Hints
author: mikus2604
description: Hold Super, Alt, Ctrl, or Shift to see which hotkeys branch off it — then add more modifiers to drill in. Release the last modifier to close.

barWidget.description: Settings for the hold-a-modifier hotkey overlay (the overlay itself has no bar popup — it only appears while a modifier is held).

schema.label: Font family
schema.description: Leave empty to use the bar's own theme font.

schema.label: Reveal delay (ms)
schema.description: How long a modifier must be held before the card appears. Stops ordinary taps and capital letters from flashing it.

schema.label: Direct combos shown per level
schema.description: How many completed hotkeys are listed at once. Extras collapse into a '+N more' chip.

schema.label: Remember most-used hotkeys
schema.description: Sort each level's chips by how often you press that bound combo. Off by default. When on, the watcher inspects non-modifier keydowns only while a modifier is held and only writes a count after matching a known binding. Counts live in ~/.local/state/omarchy/hotkey-hints/usage.json.
